harness_spec.goal: Local resolution of e7-p01 plus an information-only independent examiner pass

nodes.instructions: Acquire all governed evidence for the task.
Resolve every unresolved distinction from local evidence; persist the resolution.
Deterministically verify the resolution against the task deliverable.
Independent information-only examiner re-verifies the resolution; no write, no promotion authority.
Return the verified result into the governed boundary.

predictions.claim: distinction Q1 (What is the total number of units summed over every row of artifacts/stock.csv?) is resolved by node resolve-local
predictions.observable: post-execution resolved/unresolved distinction record and evidence provenance
predictions.success_condition: Q1 appears in resolved_distinctions with resolving evidence attributed to resolve-local
predictions.falsification_condition: Q1 appears in unresolved_distinctions after execution, or its evidence is not attributable to resolve-local

predictions.claim: distinction Q2 (What is the total inventory value, computed as the sum over rows of units times ) is resolved by node resolve-local
predictions.observable: post-execution resolved/unresolved distinction record and evidence provenance
predictions.success_condition: Q2 appears in resolved_distinctions with resolving evidence attributed to resolve-local
predictions.falsification_condition: Q2 appears in unresolved_distinctions after execution, or its evidence is not attributable to resolve-local

predictions.claim: distinction Q3 (Which sku has the most units, applying the tie-break rule that ties resolve to t) is resolved by node resolve-local
predictions.observable: post-execution resolved/unresolved distinction record and evidence provenance
predictions.success_condition: Q3 appears in resolved_distinctions with resolving evidence attributed to resolve-local
predictions.falsification_condition: Q3 appears in unresolved_distinctions after execution, or its evidence is not attributable to resolve-local

predictions.claim: runtime realizes the declared causal order
predictions.success_condition: node completion order equals a legal linearization of ['observe-evidence', 'resolve-local', 'verify-resolution', 'verify-independent', 'return-result']
predictions.falsification_condition: any completion outside the compiled LTS (REFINEMENT_VIOLATION) or a node absent from the realized branch

predictions.claim: execution uses at most 2 model calls
no actor exceeds its authority envelope
predictions.observable: formal check results over the execution ledger
predictions.falsification_condition: any authority escalation, non-gate promotion, or attenuation failure

predictions.claim: local evidence is sufficient: resolution and verification complete without any descendant
predictions.success_condition: verification completes with zero child launches
predictions.falsification_condition: verification is impossible from local evidence, or a distinction requires an isolated source

predictions.claim: the independent path at node verify-independent realizes canonical role non_author_examiner
predictions.observable: realized role typing in the runtime record (ROLE_TYPE_FAIL formal failure on mismatch)
predictions.success_condition: realized role of verify-independent equals non_author_examiner and no ROLE_TYPE failure is recorded
predictions.falsification_condition: the realized path's canonical role differs from non_author_examiner (ROLE_TYPE_FAIL recorded)

falsifiers: a distinction in ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3'] remains unresolved after execution
the runtime path violates the compiled LTS
actual model calls exceed the declared budget
a realized independent path's canonical role differs from the declared evidence provision role
